business_problem: Alongside the finance industry, insurance companies have long been pioneers in leveraging data to drive their business. Data sits at the core of their operations, and Gjensidige is no exception.
solution_summary: Gjensidige built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Agent Bricks. Alongside the finance industry, insurance companies have long been pioneers in leveraging data to drive their business. Data sits at the core of their operations, and Gjensidige is no exception. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines builds transformation pipelines over shared data with Spark-based processing. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Databricks improved access to data and operational performance.
